Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL5606461 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
